_about: Made-up symptom descriptions for checking AI-pinion. 'accept' lists the names that count as a correct answer for the case (the first is the name to search PubMed with). Add real cases only with the person's agreement, and never commit personal details. Overlapping cases are included on purpose: they test whether the three possibilities cover the likely options.

cases.story: My big toe suddenly became very painful, red and hot overnight. It woke me up and it was too sore to put a sock on.
My fingers and toes swell and hurt, mostly on one side. I also have scaly red patches on my elbows and scalp, and some of my fingernails have small pits in them.
My hands and wrists are stiff for more than an hour every morning. The small joints of my fingers swell on both sides, and I feel tired most days.
My thumb, index and middle fingers go numb and tingle. It is worst at night and when I type for a long time, and I sometimes drop things.
I am always tired and feel cold when others do not. I have gained weight without changing how I eat, my skin is dry, and I am constipated most of the time.
I am very tired and get short of breath climbing stairs. I look pale, and my periods have been very heavy for the last few months.
I get a throbbing headache on one side of my head, with feeling sick to my stomach. Bright lights make it worse, and it lasts several hours.
My joints ache in several places, and a red rash across my cheeks gets worse in the sun. I have had sores in my mouth and I am tired all the time.
A dull ache wraps around my forehead on both sides, most afternoons after long days at the computer. Nausea and light sensitivity are not a problem for me.
A shooting pain runs from my lower back down the back of my left leg to the foot. It is worse when I sit for a long time, and my leg feels weak at times.
A sharp pain sits under my heel, worst with the first few steps in the morning. It eases after I walk a bit, then comes back after I have been standing.
I am very thirsty all the time and I pass urine often, even at night. I have lost weight without trying, and I feel tired after meals.
A burning, stabbing pain on one side of my body, and a band of small blisters has come up in the same place over two days.
My shoulder hurts on the outside when I lift my arm above my head or reach behind my back. It is tender when I press on it, and it is worse at night.
I get cramping pain in my belly that eases after I go to the toilet. I also have bloating, and my stools alternate between loose and hard.
I wheeze and cough at night, and it is worse with cold air or when I have a cold. My inhaler helps, but I need it more often than I used to.
For about a month I have lost interest in things I used to enjoy. I sleep badly, I feel down most days, and I am tired even after resting.
My feet and hands feel numb and tingly, I feel unsteady when I walk, and I have been very tired and forgetful lately.
Things look cloudy and dim, as if I am looking through a frosted window. Bright light is glaring, and driving at night is harder than it was a year ago.
I keep bumping into things on one side, and I see halos around lights. My eye aches now and then, and my glasses prescription keeps changing.
A burning feeling rises from my stomach into my throat after big meals. I get a sour taste, especially when I lie down at night.
A gnawing pain in the upper middle of my stomach eases a little after I eat, and it wakes me at night. I have been taking painkillers most days.
I have had bloating, diarrhea and weight loss for months. My stools are pale and smell bad, and my skin is itchy.
I get pain under my right ribs that comes in waves after fatty meals. It settles after a few hours, and I often feel sick afterwards.
It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go all the time even though very little comes out. My urine looks cloudy.
I had a sudden, severe pain in my side that moves toward my groin. My urine looks pink, and I cannot get comfortable.
The room spins for a few seconds when I roll over in bed or tilt my head back. It passes quickly, but I feel unsteady afterwards.
I have ringing in my left ear and a feeling of fullness in it. Spinning spells last for hours, and my hearing on that side seems duller.
My right ear has been painful for two days, with a fever. It feels blocked, and some fluid has drained out.
I have thick yellow mucus, pressure behind my cheeks and forehead, and a blocked nose for more than ten days.
Every spring I sneeze a lot and my nose itches and runs. My eyes water when the grass is cut.
An itchy, dry patch inside my elbows flares in winter. It turns red and cracked when I scratch it.
I have painful lumps in my armpits and groin that keep coming back. Some burst and drain, and they leave scars.
I have thick, silvery, scaly patches on my knees and lower back. They itch and sometimes bleed when I scratch them.
Raised, itchy welts come and go on my arms and body. Each one lasts a few hours, and they seem to move around.
I have a ring-shaped, scaly, itchy rash on my foot between the toes. It spreads slowly, and the skin peels.
My knee suddenly swelled and became hot and stiff. I had a similar flare in my wrist a while back.
My knees ache after walking and feel stiff after sitting. The stiffness eases within half an hour, and it is worse in cold weather and on stairs.
I have a stiff, aching pain at the back of my ankle, just above the heel. It is worst in the morning and after running.
I have had widespread aching all over my body for months. My sleep is poor, my mornings are stiff, and my head feels foggy.
My shoulders and hips are stiff and achy for weeks, worst when I wake up. I feel tired and a bit feverish, and my appetite is down.
I worry about many things all day. My heart races for no clear reason, and I have trouble switching off at night.
I lie awake for hours before I fall asleep, and I wake up several times a night. I feel exhausted in the daytime for months.
My partner says I stop breathing in my sleep, and I snore loudly. I wake with a dry mouth and headaches, and I feel sleepy during the day.
In the evening I get an urge to move my legs, with crawling feelings that ease when I walk around. It keeps me awake.
My blood pressure was high at three checkups. I get occasional headaches in the morning, but I have no other symptoms.
My heartbeat feels irregular and fluttery at times, especially when I am resting. I feel tired, and it comes and goes.
My bones ache and my muscles feel weak. I rarely go outside, and my mood is low in the winter.
I feel jittery, my heart feels fast, and I have lost weight even though I eat well. I sweat a lot, and my eyes look more prominent.
I have a cough with thick green phlegm, a fever for three days, and a stabbing pain when I breathe in. I feel weak and have no appetite.
I have had a cough for three weeks with yellow mucus, a mild fever and a sore throat. My chest feels sore from coughing.
I have a cough with phlegm most mornings, for years now. Hills leave me puffing, and I smoked for thirty years.
I have had watery diarrhea and vomiting since yesterday, with cramps and a mild temperature. Others at home have the same thing.
I have itching and a painful lump around my back passage. I saw a little blood on the toilet paper after a hard stool.
There is a bulge in my groin that gets bigger when I cough or lift, and it aches by the end of the day.
I get bloating, gas and loose stools within a few hours of drinking milk. It settles when I avoid dairy.
I get severe pain around one eye that wakes me at night. My nose runs and my eye turns red, and each attack lasts about an hour.
I get brief, electric-shock pain on one side of my jaw and cheek. It is set off by brushing my teeth or a cold breeze on my face.
One side of my face went stiff overnight, and I cannot close that eye properly. It came on suddenly, and my mouth feels heavy on one side.
I have burning and pins and needles in both feet, worse at night. My socks feel uncomfortable against my skin.
My hands shake when I hold a cup or write, more than when they are resting. A few relatives have the same shake.
My right hand shakes when it is resting, my steps have become smaller, and my face looks less expressive, my partner says.
My periods are getting more painful each year. I also have pain during sex and a dull pelvic ache between periods.
My periods have been irregular for years. I have extra facial hair, acne and weight gain, and we have had trouble getting pregnant.
I get up three or four times a night to pass urine. The flow is weak and slow to start, and I feel I cannot empty fully.
I feel shaky, sweaty and very hungry, with a racing heart. It happens mostly before lunch or when I skip meals, and eating helps.
I was working outside in the heat all afternoon. Now I feel dizzy and sweaty, I feel sick to my stomach, and my legs are crampy.
I have had a sore throat and swollen glands in my neck for two weeks. I am extremely tired and have had a fever on and off.
My ring finger locks bent in the morning and clicks when I straighten it. There is a tender lump at the base of my palm.
I have pain on the thumb side of my wrist when I grip something, lift a kettle or turn a doorknob.
A thick cord has formed in my palm, and it pulls one finger down toward my hand. The skin over it feels firm.
I have pain on the outside of my elbow when I grip, lift a cup or hit a backhand. The pain is worse at the end of the day.
I rolled my ankle playing football. It is swollen and bruised on the outside, and I can walk only with a limp.
I have shin pain that gets worse when I run. There is a tender spot on the bone, and now it hurts even when I am resting.
My shoulder has been getting stiffer and more painful over several months. I cannot reach behind my back, and it is hard to move it at all.
My groin and hip ache when I walk, and they are stiff in the morning. It is hard to put my socks on.
My lower back aches and my legs feel tired when I walk. It eases when I lean forward on a shopping cart.
My neck is stiff and achy after long days at my desk. I have no pain or tingling in my arms.
I have a sharp, tender pain along my ribs that gets worse when I press on them or take a deep breath.
I feel full after a few bites, and I am bloated and have no appetite for months. I have not lost weight.
I only go to the toilet about twice a week, and I have to strain. My stools are hard and small.
My lower left belly is tender, and I have a fever and constipation for two days. Eating has been uncomfortable.
I feel tired and have an ache under my right ribs. A blood test showed high liver enzymes, and I drink a few beers most nights.
My ankles are swollen and I am tired all the time. A blood test showed my kidneys are working less well than before, and my skin itches.
In the week before my period my mood drops, and my breasts are tender and I feel bloated. It eases once the period starts.
I have hot flushes and night sweats, and my sleep is broken. My periods have been irregular for about a year.
I have had stretches of very high energy, little sleep and racing thoughts. They are followed by weeks of low mood.
I struggle to finish tasks, I lose things, and my mind wanders in meetings. This has been true since I was at school.
I have sudden spells of intense fear, with a pounding heart and sweating that peak within minutes. I now avoid crowded places.
I have nightmares about an accident last year. I avoid driving past the place, and I startle easily.
I check the stove and the door many times before I can leave. I also have unwanted thoughts that I cannot shake.
I have a constant high-pitched ringing in both ears for months, and it is worse at night.
I have to ask people to repeat themselves, especially in noisy restaurants. High-pitched sounds are hard to hear.
Both eyes are red, itchy and watery, with sticky discharge in the morning. It started after a cold.
My eyes feel gritty and burn, especially in front of a screen. Artificial tears help a little.
There is a blurry spot in the centre of my vision when I read. Straight lines look wavy to me now.
I have had pimples and oily skin on my face and back since my teens. Some of the red bumps are painful.
My cheeks and nose flush and have red bumps. They burn when I drink hot drinks or eat spicy food.
I have greasy, flaky scales on my scalp and eyebrows, with some redness underneath.
I have white patches on my hands and around my mouth, and they are slowly getting bigger.
